title: Taj Mahal Minarets Secret
idea: The Taj Mahal's minarets were deliberately constructed tilting outward so that they fall away from the main tomb during an earthquake.

lines.text: Taj Mahal ke chaar meenarein seedhi nahi, balki thodi teedhi hain!
Ye chaar meenarein 40 meter se bhi zyada lambi hain.
Isse banane mein 20,000 se zyada majdooron ne kaam kiya tha!
Marble mein 28 alag tarah ke keemti patthar jade gaye the!
Bhookamp aane par meenarein bahar girengi, mukhya maqbare par nahi!
Kya aapko Taj Mahal ka ye hidden secret pata tha? Comment karo!

facts.claim: The minarets were constructed slightly oriented towards the outside so that in a collapse, material falls away from the tomb.
Each of the four minarets is more than 40 metres tall.
More than 20,000 workers were employed in construction.
28 types of precious and semi-precious stone were inlaid into the white marble.
